heading: The basics matter.
body: Show up prepared. Keep the work area under control. Say what is changing. Finish the details. Those habits are not extras—they are the job.

points.title: Direct contact
points.body: You work with the person responsible for the scope and the result.

points.title: Clear expectations
points.body: Questions, constraints, and next steps are discussed before work moves ahead.

points.title: Respect for the site
points.body: Access, cleanup, neighbors, tenants, and ongoing operations are considered.
